classRootPolicy.reason: Component class roots are derived from accepted React component owner roots plus reviewed extension roots. Protected roots are high-risk visual owners that must be composed, not copied. Field is protected as a shared CSS/primitive contract owned by field-like React components, not as a standalone wrapper.

docsAllowedPackageClassTokens.reason: Docs layout uses Tag as a transitional package-backed navigation marker while component demos remain package-owned.

blockedConceptClassPatterns.message: Search must use searchSlotMarkup/search-slot as the single visual source; do not keep a parallel topbar search implementation.
Account menu must use avatarMenuMarkup as the single visual source; do not keep a parallel account menu implementation.
Overlays must compose Dialog, Drawer, Popover, Menu, Action Sheet, or Fullscreen Sheet; do not keep a parallel overlay surface.
Structural grouping must use the Surface primitive; Card must not become a generic group wrapper.
Bottom sheet behavior must resolve through Action Sheet or Fullscreen Sheet patterns; do not keep a parallel sheet implementation.
Roles and permissions must compose Roles And Permissions; do not keep a parallel permissions matrix.
Alert and feedback strips must compose Toast, Inline Validation, Badge, or Error Panel according to the formal slot.
Topbar navigation must compose Topbar or its documented boundary slots; do not keep a parallel shell implementation.
Table toolbars must compose Toolbar or Virtual Data Table boundaries; do not keep a parallel table action bar.
Field shells must use the shared .field contract through Flow field-like React components; do not keep a parallel Field wrapper or raw field implementation.
Status and feedback views must compose EmptyState, ErrorPanel, Inline Validation, Toast, Notification Panel, or Snackbar Provider according to the formal slot.
Conversational UI composition must route through formal Flow component, pattern, or template contracts; do not keep a parallel chat shell copied from ZIP references.
Chart visuals must route through Chart Panel, the Charts primitive, or Chart Wrapper; do not keep standalone copied chart components or local chart shells.
Payment and wallet UI must compose Card Summary, Flow field-like components, Code Input, card inputs, or Driver Card Wallet boundaries; do not keep copied ZIP wallet/input shells.
Data-heavy composites must compose Table, Virtual Data Table, Bulk Actions, Tree View, Timeline, KPI, or template boundaries; do not keep copied ZIP table/board shells.
Map and route experiences must route through the Maps primitive, Station Pin, Route Summary, Station Discovery, or route templates; do not keep copied ZIP map canvases or direct runtime shells.

Selection and date flows must compose Select, Combobox, Country Selector, Multi Select, Select Option Layer, Date Picker, Date Range Picker, Calendar View, or Advanced Filters; do not keep copied ZIP selector/date shells.
Navigation and onboarding shells must compose Topbar, Sidebar, Tabs, Stepper, Multi Step Form, Drawer Adapter, or governed onboarding templates; do not keep copied ZIP navigation/onboarding wrappers.

Feedback, progress, and authentication surfaces must compose Notification Panel, Snackbar Provider, Toast, Progress Indicator, Spinner, Empty State, Error Panel, Dialog, Drawer, Biometric Prompt, or Authentication Login Biometrics And OTP; do not keep copied ZIP feedback/auth shells.

Media and separator helpers must compose Card, Surface, List, Timeline, Menu separators, Breadcrumbs separators, or illustration/animation primitives; do not keep copied ZIP CardMedia or Divider shells.

Email and mailing templates require a separate governed channel contract; product React patterns/templates must use Message, Toast, Notification Panel, or a future email template contract instead of copied ZIP mailing shells.
